About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Discover Adjila School
About.historyText: Founded in 2009 in the city of El Bayadh, Adjila School is the first private institution specialized in state-accredited education and vocational training in the wilaya. Since its establishment, the school has been committed to providing high-quality education that meets the needs of the local community and the demands of the job market.
About.missionText: We strive to empower every learner to acquire the knowledge and skills needed to build a successful professional future, through a stimulating educational environment and diverse accredited training programs.
About.value1Desc: We are committed to providing the highest quality standards in education and training
About.value2Desc: All our programs are accredited by the Algerian state
About.value3Desc: We ensure our curricula are updated to keep pace with scientific and professional developments
About.value4Desc: We contribute to the development of the wilaya of El Bayadh by training local talent
About.directorText: Since founding Adjila School in 2009, our primary goal has been to provide outstanding educational and training opportunities for the residents of the wilaya of El Bayadh. We are proud of the trust that parents and learners have placed in us over more than 16 years of dedication and excellence.
About.accreditationText: Adjila School is accredited by the Algerian state as an education and vocational training institution in the wilaya of El Bayadh.
